outer surface. If the stress amplitude (𝜎𝐴) is 100 𝑀𝑃𝑎 and the critical stress 1
2  then the crack length at 
which the component will fail catastrophically is ____ 𝑚𝑚.  
(Round off to one decimal place) intensity factor 𝐾𝐼𝐶 of the material is 50 𝑀𝑃𝑎. 𝑚 Given: The geometric factor 𝛼 for this loading condition is 1.12.
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 62.5 to 64.5.
